firstScreen.notes: 1440-first.jpg: h1 7 words, trade+city+outcome, 3 lines; ochre primary + outlined call; phone in header and hero; Sample-rated proof line; tint ticket signature in hero. Only a 10px stripe peeks, the next band does not (-0.5). 390-first.jpg: h1 3 lines, both actions above fold, sticky bar.

distinctiveness.notes: Ticket system in 6+ sections doing real work (1440-first.jpg hero, services caps and footer in 1440-full.jpg, review tickets in 1440-scroll-75.jpg). Hero skeleton mirrors painter/A/qa/screens/1440-first.jpg: boxed mono kicker, text left, document card right, same CTA pair and meta line (-0.5). Chip fan in 1440-scroll-25.jpg is the swatch-fan cliché (-0.5).

type.notes: Antonio condensed carries the tint-label idea, with strong scale contrast in 1440-first.jpg and the 2.2 GALLONS numeral in 1440-full.jpg. Hyphen ranges '$450-$900' (1440-first.jpg) and '8 am - 5:30 pm' (390-full.jpg footer) cost -0.5. Cloud of tracked mono caps labels in 1440-first.jpg and 1440-scroll-75.jpg costs -0.5.

layout.notes: 1440-full.jpg: 12 bands with good tone alternation and no dark-on-dark touch; asymmetric prep in 1440-scroll-50.jpg. Sheen band leaves its right column mostly empty (1440-full.jpg ~y6500, -0.5). ZIP band is a narrow centred column floating in 1440 width (1440-full.jpg ~y9200, -0.5).

photo.notes: No stock; all drawn and on-palette: drawdown card (1440-first.jpg), chips (1440-scroll-25.jpg), siding layer stack (1440-scroll-50.jpg). The sheen visual in 1440-full.jpg is a generic diagonal gradient that doesn't show sheen.

copy.notes: Trade nouns (80-grit, stain-blocking primer, cut in) in 1440-scroll-50.jpg; honest 'exact number comes after we see the walls' in 1440-scroll-25.jpg; Sample labels on reviews, rating, prices and licence (1440-scroll-75.jpg, 390-full.jpg). Footer meta line about artwork is builder-speak (390-full.jpg).

mobile.notes: 390-full.jpg: re-composed for the phone (ticket stacks under CTAs, prep pin becomes a stack, sheen pills wrap, single-column form with 48px rows, sticky bar). No overflow at 320/390 per render.json. Footer hours wrap to 2 lines in the 2-column grid.

a11y.notes: 1440-rm-full.jpg and 390-rm-full.jpg show every section and word. Skip link, focus-visible, forced-colors and aria-live are in dist/index.html; app.js sets slider aria-valuetext and tab roles; no console errors in render.json.

motion.notes: 1440-scroll-50.jpg: scrubbed prep layer build with a progress rule explains the order. Split headings, signature draw, paused-state marquee, counters and Lenis; pinned only on desktop (390-full.jpg is stacked). No single memorable motion idea yet.

wow.notes: 1440-scroll-25.jpg: price tool outputs a printable scope ticket in the signature language. Gallon math in 1440-full.jpg gives 2.2 GALLONS with can pictograms. The two moments aren't linked.

polish.notes: Favicon, apple-touch, OG, HousePainter JSON-LD, print and forced-colors present. Pill 999px sheen tabs (1440-full.jpg sheen band) clash with the square ticket radius (-0.5).

elevate.move: Make the drawdown pull the page's divider: each band opens with a drawdown wipe in its own colour that stops at that section's coverage, replacing the generic stripe and the chip fan, so the page reads as one test card pulled down the scroll and can't be mistaken for painter-A's cover layout.

Let type become the ticket: set the prep/gallon result as a tint formula with Antonio display numerals in a strict tabular column against small Karla units, and cut the mono caps labels to one tier so the condensed numbers carry the lab-print idea.
